title: Invoice
description: A statement of the money due for goods or services; a bill.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

accountId.title: Account Id
accountId.description: The identifier for the account the payment will be applied to.

billingPeriod.title: Billing Period
billingPeriod.description: The time interval used to compute the invoice.

broker.title: Broker
broker.description: An entity that arranges for an exchange between a buyer and a seller.  In most cases a broker never acquires or releases ownership of a product or service involved in an exchange.  If it is not clear whether an entity is a broker, seller, or buyer, the latter two terms are preferred.

category.title: Category
category.description: A category for the item. Greater signs or slashes can be used to informally indicate a category hierarchy.

category_text.title: Category (text)
category_text.description: A category for the item. Greater signs or slashes can be used to informally indicate a category hierarchy.

confirmationNumber.title: Confirmation Number
confirmationNumber.description: A number that confirms the given order or payment has been received.

customer.title: Customer
customer.description: Party placing the order or paying the invoice.

minimumPaymentDue.title: Minimum Payment Due
minimumPaymentDue.description: The minimum payment required at this time.

paymentDueDate.title: Payment Due Date
paymentDueDate.description: The date that payment is due.

paymentMethod.title: Payment Method
paymentMethod.description: The name of the credit card or other method of payment for the order.

paymentMethod_text.title: Payment Method (text)
paymentMethod_text.description: The name of the credit card or other method of payment for the order.

paymentMethodId.title: Payment Method Id
paymentMethodId.description: An identifier for the method of payment used (e.g. the last 4 digits of the credit card).

paymentStatus.title: Payment Status
paymentStatus.description: The status of payment; whether the invoice has been paid or not.

paymentStatus_text.title: Payment Status (text)
paymentStatus_text.description: The status of payment; whether the invoice has been paid or not.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: The service provider, service operator, or service performer; the goods producer. Another party (a seller) may offer those services or goods on behalf of the provider. A provider may also serve as the seller.

referencesOrder.title: References Order
referencesOrder.description: The Order(s) related to this Invoice. One or more Orders may be combined into a single Invoice.

scheduledPaymentDate.title: Scheduled Payment Date
scheduledPaymentDate.description: The date the invoice is scheduled to be paid.
